verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents inviting your accountant to access real-time data and to adjust the books, including journal entries, base currency adjustments, reconciliation and reports, with an audit trail noted. The evidence never describes role-scoped permissions for the invited accountant; API OAuth scopes are a developer feature and do not count toward user roles. missing for 10: documented role/permission scoping for invited accountants, detail on the invite flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books

citations.quote: Invite your accountant in Zoho Books to access real-time data. From handling journal entries and base currency adjustments to reconciliation and generating reports accountants can effortlessly manage your books from anywhere.
